question: Kanaklata Barua was a teenaged freedom fighter from ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanaklata Barua **was a teenage freedom fighter who was shot dead in **Assam **during the Quit India Movement.
 
• She was one of the youngest martyrs of the Quit India Movement.
 
• She led the Mukti Bahini to unfurl the Tricolour at the Gohpur police station on September 20, 1942.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICGS Kanaklata Barua** is the fifth and last in a series of FPVs built by **Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) Ltd.**
 
• The other four are:
 
 
• ICGS Priyadarshini
 
• ICGS Annie Besant.
 
• ICGS Kamala Devi.
 
• ICGS Amrit Kaur.
